{{Top}}
[[File:Droid_detector.jpg|thumb|250px|The droid detector at Chalmun's Cantina]]
{{Quote|Hey! We don't serve their kind here!|[[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''droid detector''' was a device that detected [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. An [[EPT-212]] droid detector was installed in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].
